bugs.description: A repository-import storage rejection is translated into an accepted HTTP status.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: Import persistence rejects before writing the repository record.
bugs.observableImpact: The API acknowledges an import that was never stored.
bugs.provenance: Seeded mutation with a paired deterministic base and head proof.

bugs.description: The swallowed persistence error lets the unchanged caller enqueue indexing for a missing import record.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: Persistence fails and processImport continues after acceptImport resolves.
bugs.observableImpact: Downstream indexers receive an identifier whose repository import record does not exist.
bugs.provenance: Seeded mutation with a paired deterministic base and head proof.
